text:
zoe: Alert from LogDNA showed a pasted ciphertext field inside a merchant support ticket body. Looks like a Vault-wrapped blob (header: projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/merchant-kr/cryptoKeys/merchant-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/7). Ticket visible to external vendor support.

ben: yikes. Do we have any Decrypt entries around that time? Which principal used it?

zoe: quick grep: one Decrypt by principal `merchant-int-sa@merchant.org` at 2026-06-11T08:12:03Z. Ticket was created at 08:18Z. Seems they pulled ciphertext then pasted into ticket.

claire: I'll take Vault side. Plan: enumerate secrets under secret/merchant and fetch metadata only. No decrypts in our env.

marta: I'll own KMS/Audit. Immediate steps I propose: 1) apply a temporary deny on merchant-int-sa for the cryptoKey, 2) export KMS Decrypt logs to forensics BigQuery dataset with a retention tag, 3) alert on any new Decrypt by principals outside our org.

ops-bot: INC-2026-402 created: "Merchant support ticket contains KMS-wrapped Vault ciphertext". Assigned to @zoe and @marta. Priority P2.

ben: Rotation options: a) server-side rewrap if cloud provider supports it (preferred), b) create new key version and rewrap by decrypt+encrypt inside an ephemeral hardened VM with logging disabled (must avoid disk and persistent logs).

claire: Runbook (staging-first) snippet: 
```
# enumerate metadata
vault kv list -format=json secret/merchant || true
vault read -format=json secret/merchant/payment_creds | jq .data.metadata
# do not attempt decryption here
```
I'll collect the list and hand to eng-security for rewrap.

marta: On KMS: creating new key version now (v8) in our-proj. Will attempt server-side re-encrypt API; if not available we'll schedule ephemeral VM flow.

ben: Important: rotate any Vault service tokens/consumer SA keys that have read access to secret/merchant. Add temporary deny for those SAs where feasible. Keep the old key version enabled for 15 minutes post-rotation to allow retry, then revoke.

claire: agreed. Also will rotate long-lived tokens listed in the Vault access audit and issue short-lived dynamic tokens for consumers.

zoe: Notifying merchant security and legal (need disclosure steps). Told merchant they should expect temporary disruption to integrations for ~30-60m.

marta: Forensics: snapshot KMS and Vault audit logs into investigation bucket with strict ACL and write a chain-of-custody note. Also enabling an alert to page eng-security on any Decrypt for merchant-wrap by external principals.

ben: Post-rotation checklist: 1) rewrap ciphertexts and write back to Vault with metadata meta.rotated_by=eng-security meta.kms_version=8 meta.rotated_at=2026-06-11T09:00:00Z 2) rotate consumer creds/tokens 3) revoke external SA denies after verification 4) monitor errors and rollback if we see mass failures.

claire: I'll prepare a small CI-safe script to write rotated ciphertexts into Vault (no plaintext handling). Will post it shortly.

zoe: please also add a temporary policy to disable public-facing ticket attachments for merchant support until we confirm there are no other leaks.

ben: I'll coordinate IAM deny and re-enable alerting. Update thread as steps complete. :white_check_mark:
